title: Whole genome CRISPR screening strategy to identify genes contributing to SARS-CoV-2 spike and VSV-G mediated entry
model: ACE2-HEK293T cells, Brunello genome-wide knockout library, pseudovirus reporter FACS sorts
contrast: Reporter-low vs high, SARS-CoV-2 spike screen (1 vs 1); VSV-G-mNeonGreen and VSV-G-Cre counter-screens also analyzed
paper_method: MAGeCK (differential screen strategy; paper not open access)
paper_calls: ACE2 and LDLR identified as the spike and VSV-G receptors by the counter-screen strategy
barcs_calls: 30 genes at FDR 0.10 in the spike screen (13 and 28 in the VSV-G screens), screening-level
named_hits: ACE2 #1 in the spike screen (FDR 6e-10) and non-significant in VSV-G; LDLR a top-10 enriched gene in both VSV-G screens and non-significant in spike; SLC35B2 top-5 in all three
verdict: BARCS reproduces the paper's differential result exactly: ACE2 tops the spike screen only, LDLR the VSV-G screens only, and the shared factor SLC35B2 is a top hit throughout.
